summary: Re-tested the vapi_webhook tool-calls fix, backend only. 17 of 17 tests pass: 10 new tests plus the 7 regression tests from iteration 9. The iteration 9 failure is fixed. A tool-calls message for an unknown call now returns results[0] with the matching toolCallId and a result containing 'closing line is spoken automatically'. Attempt and audit counts do not change, and the backend logs the warning 'Disposition for unknown call'. Arguments sent as a JSON string also work. An invalid disposition returns 'Invalid disposition'. A wrong tool name returns 'Unknown tool'. A bad token returns 401. With several tool calls, each toolCallId gets its own result. A status-update for an unknown call still returns {ok:true, ignored:'unknown call'}. For the known-attempt check, I did not touch live data. I inserted an isolated TEST_ attempt (finalized False) straight into Mongo, then deleted it and its audit rows afterwards. Matching by provider_call_id and by metadata.attempt_id both set agent_disposition and agent_summary, and exactly one agent_disposition_filed audit row was written. No real calls, launches, retries or settings saves were made. The review mentions a 'Jev' route check, but no such route exists in this app, so it does not apply.

minor.issue: For a known but already finalized attempt, update_one matches nothing (it filters on finalized False), but cs.audit still logs agent_disposition_filed. The audit then shows a disposition that was never stored. Suggested fix: write the audit only when result.matched_count is greater than 0.

action_items: Optional: in vapi_webhook tool-calls, write the agent_disposition_filed audit only when update_one matched_count is greater than 0.
critical_code_review_comments: The tool-calls branch is now handled before the unknown-doc early return, and every toolCallId gets a result. This is correct.
Audit is written even when the finalized filter turns the update into a no-op (see minor issue).
seed_data_creation: A temporary TEST_ call_attempt (campaign_id TEST_campaign_iter10) was inserted and then deleted in fixture teardown, along with its audit rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LIVE Vapi mode: never place calls or save settings. Read the webhook token from GET /api/settings webhook_url. The known-attempt tests use an isolated attempt inserted directly into Mongo.
test_credentials: None needed. /app/memory/test_credentials.md has no credentials (header only).
